geometryPolicy: Source positions and topology are unchanged by storage compression. Normal, UV and color storage uses bounded quantization recorded per asset; it is not lossless. Packaging then preserves each source binary payload exactly without deformation or rescaling.

storageCompression.method: NORMAL SNORM16; in-range TEXCOORD UNORM16; COLOR_0 UNORM8 except exact UNORM16 for compact/villa_2. ORM image bytes and animation are unchanged.

validation.packaging: Source and compression-report hashes, all three reference images, exact embedded binary copy, parcel bounds, growth, mobile geometry limits, moving public components and exact-model PNG bindings checked.
validation.visualAcceptance: Browser scene review is recorded separately. This status is publication, not a claim of user visual approval.
